ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: stack trace attribution
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Blames the mods whose code appears in the error's stack trace, and notes vanilla, Harmony and Unity frames.

ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: message attribution
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Blames the mods named in the message text, including load-time warnings whose stack trace is pure vanilla (dependency and packageId validation, file paths).

ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: log prefix attribution
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Blames the mod that stamped its own name on the log line, e.g. "[Giddy-Up] ..." or "[Map Preview] ...". Matches the bracket tag to a single active installed mod; ambiguous or non-mod tags are ignored.

ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: Harmony patch attribution
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Reads the live Harmony registry and names the mods that patch a method in the error, even when the stack trace is pure vanilla. When two or more mods patch the same method, it flags a likely conflict by name. Local, always on.

ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: missing requirements and load order
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Checks every active mod's declared dependencies and load order against your modlist, and explains missing or inactive required mods and wrong load order, the usual root cause of missing def, missing type and unresolved reference errors. Local, always on.

ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: version mismatch
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Flags a mod that does not list support for your RimWorld version, a common cause of errors. Local, no internet.

ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: mod-shipped known issues
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Explains errors using known-issue files that mods ship inside their own folder (ModernDevTools/known-issues.json), same format as the community database. Local, always on.

ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: declared incompatibilities
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Flags when two active mods declare each other incompatible in their own About.xml, a common cause of errors the community databases may not list. Local, always on.

ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: community databases
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Uses the opt-in community databases to suggest replacements for outdated mods and flag known incompatibilities. Enable community data in the Modules window.

ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: community bug database
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Matches errors against the community bug and fix database (our own contributor-editable JSON on GitHub). Enable community data in the Modules window.

ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: knowledge library
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Explains the error in plain language, and suggests a fix, using the shipped and third-party knowledge library.

ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.label: plain-language glossary
ModernDevTools.ErrorModuleDef.description: Adds a short "Terms in this error" card that defines any modding jargon in the error or its explanations (Harmony, def, xpath, TPS, load order and more), so the log is readable without prior knowledge.
